listing.name: Roll Away / Kula World / KulaQuest — roll-away-psx-pc-recomp (Bitsandbreakpoints)
listing.summary: The project describes a native playable game and title-screen/gameplay features for three regions. Completion of every level has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS00724 or Europe SCES01000 or Japan SCPS10064 BIN/CUE/CHD; ISO loses audio

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the README’s roll-away-pc.zip setup, run roll_away.exe and select your own supported image. Assets are read from the disc; no BIOS is required.

warnings: The project describes a native playable game and title-screen/gameplay features for three regions. Completion of every level has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
